reconstructed_theorem_text: Let E be a finite-dimensional complete real inner-product space equipped with its Borel measurable structure. Let V:E→ℝ be C², and let κ∈ℝ≥0 satisfy κ≥1 and κ⁻¹‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤‖v‖² for every x,v∈E. For every η,c,ε∈ℝ with 0<η≤c<1 and ε>0, define T_y(x)=y−η∇V(x), F_y(x)=V(x)+(η⁻¹/2)‖x−y‖², and x_j(y)=T_y^[j](y). There exist measurable p:E→E and N:E→ℕ such that y↦x_{N(y)}(y) is measurable and, for every y∈E: (1) p(y)+η∇V(p(y))=y; (2) for every z∈E, F_y(p(y))+((κ⁻¹+η⁻¹)/2)‖z−p(y)‖²≤F_y(z), and F_y(z)≤F_y(p(y)) iff z=p(y); (3) ‖x_{N(y)+1}(y)−x_{N(y)}(y)‖≤(1−η)ε, whereas this inequality fails for every natural j<N(y); (4) ‖x_{N(y)}(y)−p(y)‖≤ε; (5) N(y)+1≤[2+(1+log((1−c)⁻¹))/(−log c)] [1+log(1+‖∇V(y)‖/ε)]; and (6) Q(∇V,η,ε,y,N(y)+1,y)=some(x_{N(y)}(y),N(y)+1).
objects: Potential V, condition parameter κ, step η, comparison parameter c, tolerance ε, maps T_y and F_y, proximal solution p, first stopping index N, iterates x_j, and exact-real recursive interpreter Q.
domains: E: finite-dimensional complete real inner-product space with Borel measurable structure; V:E→ℝ; κ:NNReal; η,c,ε:ℝ; p:E→E; N:E→ℕ; y,z,v,x∈E; j∈ℕ.
quantifiers: For every admissible E,V,κ satisfying the regularity and Hessian hypotheses, for every η,c,ε satisfying 0<η≤c<1 and ε>0, there exist p,N working simultaneously for every y. For each y, the minimization assertions hold for every z and the earlier-test failures hold for every natural j<N(y).
assumptions: κ≥1; V is twice continuously differentiable; for all x,v, κ⁻¹‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤‖v‖²; 0<η≤c<1; ε>0. Consequently c>0, so the displayed logarithms and denominator have their ordinary real meanings.
conclusion: Measurable p,N and measurable returned-iterate map exist. Each p(y) solves the proximal equation and is the unique global minimizer of F_y, with the displayed quadratic growth bound. N(y) is the first successful step-difference test, the returned current iterate x_{N(y)} is ε-close to p(y), and the displayed bound controls N(y)+1. Q with precisely N(y)+1 fuel returns that iterate and count.
scopes: The unique-minimum assertion concerns F_y on all of E for each fixed y, not V itself. The return is x_N, not x_{N+1}; x_{N+1} is computed for the successful test. By the approved recurrence, the count N+1 records one gradient evaluation per tested step, including the successful test. Q is a noncomputable exact-real interpreter whose result records output and count, not a query-list trace. No source-fidelity verdict, finite-precision implementation guarantee, wall-clock bound, query trace, or further sampling/distributional conclusion is supplied.
constant_dependencies: The explicit count coefficient C(c)=2+(1+log((1−c)⁻¹))/(−log c) depends only on c. The other count factor depends on ‖∇V(y)‖/ε; κ and dimension do not occur explicitly in that bound. The quadratic growth coefficient depends on κ and η, and the stopping threshold on η and ε. The existential maps may depend on the preceding universally quantified data.
